_about: Machine-readable RAG / frequency rules. Human view: docs/COMPLIANCE_RULES.md (generated by `npm run rules:doc`). EVERY rule is UNVERIFIED until signed off by a named person. Not legal advice.

defaults._note: 7 and 14 are the BRD's suggested X and Y (BR-08) [TBC with Mark and Hamida, ELICITATION D1]. Hamida mentioned 'two weeks or three weeks' for head office.

rules.label: Weekly fire alarm test (fire log)
rules.legal_ref: Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005 art. 17 (maintenance); BS 5839-1 / BS 5839-6 recommend a weekly user test
rules.duty_holder: Responsible person under the FSO (Esto Care and/or landlord) [TBC per service]
rules.notes: Hamida's 'fire log' (the Grange version). Missed 17 and 24 Aug 2026 at one service, outstanding up to 3 months: the motivating example.

rules.label: Fire drill / evacuation practice
rules.legal_ref: FSO 2005 art. 15 and 21 (procedures, training); frequency is internal policy
rules.notes: Yasmin said 'fire drill once a week' (19 Nov). [TBC] Is this the same as the weekly alarm test, or a separate evacuation drill? Weekly evacuation drills would be unusual; confirm with Hamida.

rules.label: Fire exits and escape routes check
rules.legal_ref: FSO 2005 art. 14 (emergency routes and exits must be kept clear); fortnightly frequency is internal policy
rules.notes: Yasmin: 'fire exit once every two weeks' (19 Nov).

rules.label: Emergency lighting monthly function test
rules.legal_ref: FSO 2005 art. 17; BS 5266-1 (monthly flick test, annual full-duration test)

rules.label: Fire alarm system service (competent person)
rules.legal_ref: FSO 2005 art. 17; BS 5839-1 recommends servicing at intervals of no more than 6 months (some BS 5839-6 domestic-grade systems: annual)
rules.notes: Already in the Operations app as 'fire alarm certificate max 6 months'. Interval may be 12 months for Grade D systems: confirm system grade per house.

rules.label: Fire risk assessment review
rules.legal_ref: FSO 2005 art. 9: suitable and sufficient assessment, reviewed regularly and when there is reason to suspect it is no longer valid. The law sets no fixed interval; annual is common practice/policy.
rules.duty_holder: Responsible person (in supported living, confirm split with the landlord)
rules.notes: Duty is legal; the 12-month interval is policy [TBC].

rules.label: Fire extinguisher service
rules.legal_ref: FSO 2005 art. 17; BS 5306-3 (annual service by competent person)

rules.label: Gas safety record (CP12)
rules.legal_ref: Gas Safety (Installation and Use) Regulations 1998 reg. 36: landlord's annual safety check; a check done up to 2 months early can keep the original expiry date
rules.duty_holder: Landlord (often the housing association) [TBC per service]
rules.notes: Track whether Esto Care holds a copy.

rules.label: Electrical installation condition report (EICR)
rules.legal_ref: Electrical Safety Standards in the Private Rented Sector (England) Regs 2020, extended to the social rented sector by the 2025 amendment regs (new tenancies from 1 Dec 2025; existing tenancies to be inspected before 1 Nov 2026). Care homes are exempt from these regs but EAWR 1989 still applies, and BS 7671 guidance suggests 5-yearly. The report may set a shorter interval.
rules.duty_holder: Landlord (supported living) / Esto Care (registered premises it controls) [TBC]
rules.notes: If the EICR states an earlier next-inspection date, that date wins: store the date on the report, not only the 5-year rule.

rules.label: Portable appliance testing (provider-supplied appliances)
rules.legal_ref: No fixed legal interval. Electricity at Work Regulations 1989 / PUWER require equipment to be maintained safe; IET Code of Practice gives risk-based intervals.

rules.label: Energy Performance Certificate
rules.legal_ref: Energy Performance of Buildings (England and Wales) Regulations 2012: an EPC is valid for 10 years
rules.notes: The Operations app mentions 'EPC 5 or 10 years'. Statutory validity is 10 years; a 5-year figure may be an internal or landlord rule. [TBC with Hamida]. Minimum rating rules (MEES) are a separate check.

rules.label: Legionella risk assessment review
rules.legal_ref: HSWA 1974, COSHH 2002; HSE ACOP L8 and HSG274: review regularly and whenever there is reason to think it is no longer valid. No fixed legal interval; 2 years is common practice.

rules.label: Water temperature / flushing checks
rules.legal_ref: HSE HSG274 Part 2 (monthly sentinel outlet temperature checks; weekly flushing of little-used outlets)
rules.applies_to: as set by the legionella risk assessment
rules.notes: Zakir mentioned 'Legionella checked' in the daily logbook idea (18 Nov). Frequency should come from each house's risk assessment.

rules.label: Smoke and carbon monoxide alarms tested
rules.legal_ref: Smoke and Carbon Monoxide Alarm (England) Regulations 2015 as amended 2022 (alarms required, checked at start of tenancy, repaired when reported; applies to social landlords). Weekly testing is policy.
rules.applies_to: dwellings with alarms not on the main fire alarm system

rules.label: LOLER thorough examination (hoists / lifting equipment)
rules.legal_ref: Lifting Operations and Lifting Equipment Regulations 1998 reg. 9: equipment for lifting people examined at least every 6 months
rules.applies_to: only where hoists or lifts are used

rules.label: Medication audit
rules.legal_ref: HSCA 2008 (Regulated Activities) Regs 2014 reg. 12(2)(g) (proper and safe management of medicines) and reg. 17 (audit); NICE SC1 (care homes) and NG67 (community social care, incl. supported living)
rules.applies_to: services that support people with medicines
rules.notes: Medicines are recorded in PCS; this app only tracks that the audit was done and its actions (BRD 4.2). Monthly frequency is [TBC]; Hamida is turning the medication audit into a tracker.

rules.label: Support plans up to date
rules.legal_ref: HSCA 2008 Regs 2014 reg. 9 (person-centred care) and reg. 17 (accurate, complete, contemporaneous records). No fixed legal interval; review on change of need.
rules.notes: Person-level item. Interval [TBC with Hamida]. Store a person reference (initials / room) only, or link to PCS; no names in this app until the DPIA is done.

rules.label: Individual risk assessments up to date
rules.legal_ref: HSCA 2008 Regs 2014 reg. 12(2)(a)-(b) (assess and mitigate risks). No fixed legal interval.
rules.notes: Interval [TBC]. Same data-protection note as support plans.

rules.label: Local authority care and support plan review
rules.legal_ref: Care Act 2014 s.27; Care and Support Statutory Guidance ch. 13: review no later than every 12 months (first review within 6-8 weeks). The duty is the council's; we track that it happens.
rules.applies_to: per person with a council-funded package

rules.label: Support / funding package review
rules.legal_ref: Contractual / commissioning (council or ICB, incl. s117 aftercare)
rules.notes: Links to finance (one-to-one hours, fees). Interval [TBC with Yasmin / Jawad].

rules.label: DoLS / Court of Protection authorisation in date
rules.legal_ref: Mental Capacity Act 2005 Sch A1 (DoLS: care homes and hospitals, max 12 months); supported living needs Court of Protection authorisation. LPS not in force as of Nov 2026.
rules.notes: Use the actual expiry on the authorisation, which may be shorter than 12 months.

rules.label: Internal QA audit (with actions)
rules.legal_ref: HSCA 2008 Regs 2014 reg. 17(2)(a): systems to assess, monitor and improve quality and safety
rules.notes: Hamida's QA tracker has actions; each open action should appear as an Action with owner and due date. Quarterly is [TBC]. Mark will send QA documents.

rules.label: Occupancy tracker updated
rules.legal_ref: Internal (finance and voids oversight)
rules.notes: Hamida is still finalising the occupancy tracker (feedback from Abhishek). Weekly is [TBC].

rules.label: HMO licence (or exemption confirmed)
rules.legal_ref: Housing Act 2004 Part 2 (mandatory licensing: 5+ people, 2+ households); licences last up to 5 years; some councils run additional licensing. Some registered-provider-managed buildings are exempt.
rules.notes: Use the licence's actual expiry date.
